# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_KEEPER_VOLMULT1.3

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The sniper level break strategy with specific parameters aims to capture edge by entering on confirmed level breaks with volume and confluence filters, using a 40% take-profit target, 150% runner target, and an 8% catastrophe stop. The hypothesis is that this parameter set improves upon baseline by better capturing runner moves while limiting losses via tight stops, though J-edge capture remains suboptimal.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with vol_mult=1.3 (volume ≥1.3x 20-bar average), body_min_cents=0.05 (min candle body 5 cents), min_stars=2 (≥2 confluence signals), strike_offset=2 (OTM-2 put), proximity_dollars=1.5 (break within $1.5 of level), require_break_above_open=true (break must occur above open price for validity).  
**Exit:** TP1 at 40% premium (sell 2/3 position), runner target at 150% premium, catastrophe stop at 8% loss (premium stop), profit_lock disabled (threshold 0.0). No trailing profit-lock or breakeven move after TP1.
